scope: All 23 ranked optical review targets, four-date panels and local DSM. This is an interpretive screen, not field verification or an estimate of classifier accuracy.
decision_semantics: Rejected means the visible evidence does not justify archaeological follow-up priority from this screen. It does not establish absence of buried archaeology.

decisions.observation: Small patch at the northern image boundary falls in the rectilinear crop-field belt. The panel is truncated and the relative DSM difference is only +0.26 m.
The polygon follows part of a rectangular plot, green in January, bare in May and November, and partly green in October. Relative DSM is -0.83 m.
The compact contrast lies at a rectilinear plot edge within the cultivated belt. Vegetation changes between dates; relative DSM is -0.24 m.
The patch occupies a small part of the modern field grid and follows the seasonal crop pattern. Relative DSM is -0.17 m.
The 16.92 ha connected optical patch combines several straight-edged crop plots rather than an isolated mound. Relative DSM is -0.06 m.
A triangular contrast fragment lies among straight field boundaries and seasonally cultivated plots. Relative DSM is +0.10 m.
The patch follows the cultivated margin and changes with field vegetation. Relative DSM is -0.44 m.

decisions.alternative: shrub or dune margin beside cultivation
decisions.observation: A small irregular patch adjoins a square cultivated plot and the linear dune landscape. The imagery supplies no isolated raised feature; relative DSM is -0.07 m.

decisions.alternative: exposed terrain at a cultivated margin
decisions.observation: The patch sits within continuous rough terrain beside irregular cultivation and drainage. It is not a compact raised feature in the DSM; relative difference is -2.90 m.

decisions.alternative: small exposed patch on a broad natural ridge
decisions.observation: A small bright spot persists, especially in the dry-date image, but surrounding rough exposed terrain is continuous and the DSM shows a broad ridge rather than an isolated mound. The +1.78 m relative difference is insufficient to resolve the alternative.
The patch lies among irregular plots and pale disturbed ground near a linear access route. The DSM does not show an isolated raised feature; relative difference is -1.95 m.
The contrast lies at the end of a narrow field beside a continuous ridge. Its relative DSM difference is -0.10 m.
The patch borders a dark, seasonally vegetated low area. The dry-date image exposes pale low ground and the DSM gives -6.73 m relative relief.
The polygon marks the boundary between a plot and rough ridge terrain. The apparent feature is not isolated and relative DSM is -1.76 m.
The compact bright fragment lies within a longer rough ridge among cultivated fields. The +4.34 m DSM difference reflects that landscape setting and does not distinguish an archaeological mound.
The patch lies inside the modern built settlement beside a dark depression. Relative DSM is -1.34 m.
The polygon follows a curved linear low corridor crossing the modern field grid. Vegetation and exposed banks change between dates; the DSM channel is clear and relative difference is -1.95 m.
An elongated patch lies directly on a low linear drainage corridor among crop plots. Relative DSM is -0.89 m.
The small contrast is embedded within a dense modern settlement, without a distinct raised morphology. Relative DSM is -1.61 m.
The compact polygon is part of a longer curved drainage strip through fields. The DSM shows the continuous low corridor; relative difference is -1.70 m.

decisions.alternative: modern settlement and field edge; clipped context
decisions.observation: The patch lies among modern structures and straight agricultural boundaries at the southern frame edge. The clipped context and -0.62 m relative DSM difference supply no independent mound evidence.
The polygon follows the same kind of continuous low drainage corridor as other B04 optical hits. Its relative DSM difference is -1.60 m.
A small patch adjoins modern built ground and crop plots beside a major straight transport corridor. Relative DSM is -1.50 m.
